gaps: census_tenure 1950 and 1960: not found in any digitized official INE publication. INEbase historia census collection (https://www.ine.es/inebaseweb/libros.do?tntp=71807) only digitizes the population volumes for 1950 (Tomos I-III) and 1960 (Avance, Tomo I, Tomo III provincial) — no 'Censo de edificios y viviendas 1950' or 'Censo de viviendas 1960' volume. Walked the Anuario Estadístico 1952-1958 and 1960-1966 trees (https://www.ine.es/inebaseweb/libros.do?tntp=25687): 'Edificación y vivienda' sections only hold building permits/completions, rents of new dwellings and state-protected housing; 'Clasificaciones del censo 1960' only population tables. No tenure table found.

census_tenure secondary figures (NOT verified against an INE file, do not publish as official): owner-occupied main dwellings ~46% (1950) and ~51-52% (1960), as commonly cited in the Spanish housing literature from the INE housing censuses; exact citation and table not verified in this pass.

young_ownership: EFF2011 own-article value (83,1 / 69,8) was later revised by Banco de España to 82,6 / 69,3 (EFF2014 article); the series mixes own-article values as requested — use the revised reprints if strict wave-to-wave comparability is needed.

social_rental_stock: OECD and EU averages have no single reference year (cross-country average of latest years); Spain is from an earlier QuASH round (2019) and may include employer-provided reduced-rent dwellings.
